# Disin

> Standalone skeuomorphic CSS components with DaisyUI-compatible class names.

Live gallery: https://disin.vercel.app
Repository: https://github.com/ishuowang/disin
Package: disin
Component count: 68
Reference contract: DaisyUI 5.7.4
Runtime dependencies: 0
Tailwind required: no

## Agent installation

Install this repository's portable Agent Skill:

    npx skills add ishuowang/disin --skill disin -y

Install the CSS package:

    npm install disin

Import once in global CSS:

    @import "disin/styles.css";

Selective import:

    @import "disin/tokens.css";
    @import "disin/components/button.css";
    @import "disin/components/card.css";

Activate at the application root:

    <html data-theme="disin">

GitHub fallback:

    npm install github:ishuowang/disin

## Contract

- Read `disin/components.json` before composing a large interface.
- Prefer native semantic elements and states.
- Use existing component classes instead of recreating gradients or shadows.
- DaisyUI and Disin share class names. Do not import both full stylesheets unless
  cascade order and scope are intentional.
- Semantic modifiers: primary, secondary, accent, neutral, info, success,
  warning, error.
- Common sizes: xs, sm, md, lg, xl.
- The package is CSS-first and framework-independent.

## Components

Actions (6): Button, Dropdown, FAB / Speed Dial, Modal, Swap, Theme Controller.

Data display (19): Accordion, Avatar, Aura, Badge, Card, Carousel, Chat Bubble,
Collapse, Countdown, Diff, Hover 3D Card, Hover Gallery, Kbd, List, Stat,
Status, Table, Text Rotate, Timeline.

Navigation (9): Breadcrumbs, Dock, Link, Megamenu, Menu, Navbar, Pagination,
Steps, Tabs.

Feedback (7): Alert, Loading, Progress, Radial Progress, Skeleton, Toast,
Tooltip.

Data input (15): Calendar, Checkbox, Fieldset, File Input, Filter, Label, Radio,
Range Slider, Rating, Select, Text Input, Textarea, Toggle, Validator, OTP.

Layout (8): Divider, Drawer Sidebar, Footer, Hero, Indicator, Join, Mask, Stack.

Mockup (4): Browser Mockup, Code Mockup, Phone Mockup, Window Mockup.

## Minimal markup

    <div data-theme="disin">
      <article class="card">
        <div class="card-body">
          <span class="badge badge-primary">Ready</span>
          <h2 class="card-title">Tactile console</h2>
          <input class="input input-primary" placeholder="Station name">
          <div class="card-actions">
            <button class="btn">Cancel</button>
            <button class="btn btn-primary">Save</button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </article>
    </div>

Machine-readable install recipe: disin/ai.json
